items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: No, Mr. William B. Allen was handling the whole situation at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, I know. I know. It's a dew drop. The dew drop doesn't look like it used to in the old days. No. No. Dew drop's the same one. So after that, all right, when did you do- you said the Atlantic was the- no, not the Atlantic, the Star Talent was the first record. Mm-hmm. And then you went with Mercury. Yeah. Okay, do you remember who supervised those Mercury sessions? Who did that? Do you remember who got him?

No, Mr. William B. Allen was handling the whole situation at that time. So you think- I never did handle the business part of it. You can't- Was he in the studio when you did that? I just remember where. I'm sure he was. He had to be there, you know what I mean, because he was handling the business part of the situation.
That- was- did you do these at Cosmos on Rampart Street?
